story_title: Cropping Yields: Varieties, Sites, and Temporal Trends in 1931-1932
story_subtitle: Analyzing agricultural productivity across different crop varieties, locations, and years

story_pieces.narration: The 'Trebi' variety achieved the highest average yield of 44.3 units in 1931, outperforming other varieties, while 'No. 475' had the lowest average yield of 27.3 units. This highlights significant variation in variety performance.
story_pieces.question: Which crop variety had the highest and lowest average yields in 1931?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (variety vs. average yield)

story_pieces.narration: University Farm recorded the highest average yield of 39.2 units in 1931, whereas Grand Rapids had the lowest at 24.8 units. Site-specific conditions significantly impacted productivity.
story_pieces.question: Which site had the highest and lowest average yields in 1931?
story_pieces.visualization: ranked bar chart (site vs. average yield)

story_pieces.narration: From 1931 to 1932, yields for most varieties declined, with 'Manchuria' and 'Glabron' experiencing the most significant drops. This suggests possible environmental or agricultural shifts.
story_pieces.question: How did crop yields change from 1931 to 1932 across varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: bar chart race (year vs. yield per variety)

story_pieces.narration: In 1932, 'Trebi' maintained the highest yield at 33.9 units, while 'No. 457' had the lowest average yield of 26.4 units. Consistency in performance across sites was most evident for 'Trebi'.
story_pieces.question: Which variety showed the most consistent yields across sites in 1932?
story_pieces.visualization: clustered bar chart (variety vs. site yield)

story_pieces.narration: The 'Wisconsin No. 38' variety exhibited the highest yield increase from 1931 to 1932, rising from 33.4 units to 38.0 units. This indicates potential for improved cultivation practices or genetic adaptation.
story_pieces.question: Which variety showed the greatest yield improvement from 1931 to 1932?
story_pieces.visualization: line chart (year vs. yield per variety)
